game_concept: A tower defense set in Mystic Forest – Root Tunnels, tunnels among huge roots: the fairy gardener must handle wasp swarms while practicing control flow: for loops. Core idea – Range Runner: Run a for i in range(n) loop so the fairy gardener moves exactly n steps toward the elder's door.
theme: Mystic Forest – Root Tunnels: tunnels among huge roots
core_gameplay_loop: In Root Tunnels, repeat each round: Run a for i in range(n) loop so the fairy gardener moves exactly n steps toward the elder's door. Each round, wasp swarms strike the elder's door, so respond before the next strike lands. Then check the steps_left value and advance.
secondary_mechanics: Hint tokens that reveal one line of code
player_objective: Protect the elder's door from wasp swarms in Root Tunnels: keep the steps_left meter above zero by applying the concept correctly until the 51-second timer ends.
controls: Touch: tap tiles or buttons to choose values, swipe to move, long-press for a hint.
lose_condition: steps_left drops to 0, or lives reach 0, before the 51-second timer ends.
learning_alignment: Week 5 – Control Flow: For Loops | Level 8 (extended tier): Range Runner
assets_style: lush pixel-art forest: dense green canopy, a glowing blue ancient tree, winding streams and dirt paths; flat Kenney-style sprites; airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes
duplicate_check_notes: Unique combination of primary mechanic 'Range Runner' (Week 5 slot 1), mission type 'Survival Siege', and setting 'Root Tunnels'. No other file shares this combination; games sharing the mechanic differ in mission/win condition and setting, and games sharing the setting use a different mechanic.

region.name: Mystic Forest
region.mood: airy flutes, birdsong and soft magical chimes

tutorial: Step 1: Look at the code panel. It shows how steps_left changes.
Step 2: Use the controls to apply the code idea against wasp swarms in Root Tunnels.
Step 3: Win by meeting the goal: Timer reaches 51 seconds while steps_left > 0.
